subject: Re: Order Form — invoice entity / min commit / net terms (CloudWave)
messages:
From: Procurement <procurement@cloudwave.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Order form clarifications: invoicing entity, VAT, and payment terms

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for sending the draft order form. A couple of items procurement needs clarified before we can route the doc for PO issuance:

- Invoicing entity: our accounting team requires invoices to come from CloudWave EU Services (an EU entity). Can you confirm you can invoice from that entity or if Redwood requires invoices from the US parent?
- VAT / withholding: we operate in Germany and may be required to withhold VAT in some scenarios. Who is responsible for VAT on the license/usage line items?
- Minimum commit timing: the draft shows an annual commit with quarterly invoicing. We prefer an upfront quarterly charge aligned with our fiscal quarter close. Can you confirm options to split the min commit into quarterly invoices?
- Net terms: we typically do Net60 for new vendors. The order form lists Net45 — any flexibility?

We can be flexible on some points but need a short summary on these items to attach to our internal finance review.

Thanks,
Elsa
Procurement | CloudWave Inc.

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Procurement <procurement@cloudwave.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 10:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Order form clarifications: invoicing entity, VAT, and payment terms

Hi Elsa — thanks for the clear list. High-level answers below; attaching an updated order form and pricing appendix with two billing options (annual upfront vs quarterly min-commit amortized). See attachments: RW_OrderForm_v3.pdf, Pricing_Appendix_CloudWave.xlsx.

- Invoicing entity: Our standard hosted agreement invoices from Redwood Inference, Inc. (US). For customers requiring EU invoicing we can route invoices through Redwood Ireland Ltd for EU VAT purposes but this requires onboarding (entity setup) and may add a short delay to first invoice — typically 2-3 weeks.

- VAT/withholding: If invoices are issued by Redwood Ireland Ltd, VAT treatment follows Irish rules; customer withholding responsibilities should be handled by CloudWave. Where local withholding is required, we can accept a net-invoice with a credit note process to reconcile gross/gross-up mechanics — legal needs to review language.

- Min commit / invoice cadence: We can support quarterly invoicing of the agreed annual commit (3-month tranche invoices) or an upfront annual invoice. The quarterly option will include a small administrative fee for split billing; see Appendix tab B for numbers.

- Net terms: Standard is Net45; we can make an exception to Net60 for first-year onboarding for this deal only, contingent on signing the order form and approved credit review.

Next steps: I’ve looped Ben (Finance lead) and Karthik (Legal/Commercial) to confirm feasibility and get a redline back by EOD tomorrow. If that works for you we’ll send a tracked-redline order form with the EU entity option and the quarterly billing option.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: RW_OrderForm_v3.pdf (order form, 22 pages); Pricing_Appendix_CloudWave.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Order form clarifications: invoicing entity, VAT, and payment terms

Kim — quick thoughts from finance:
- Routing via Redwood Ireland Ltd is acceptable but we need CFO sign-off given EU entity billing reconciliation. Expect ~2 weeks to set up and first invoice may come from the US entity until Ireland is live.
- For withholding scenarios we prefer to preserve gross invoicing and provide credit notes / adjustments post-invoice; we don’t want to change contractual unit prices.
- Quarterly invoicing of the min commit OK, we can waive the administrative fee for strategic accounts but need the payment cadence and PO process documented in the SOW/Order Form.
- Net60 for year one is borderline but doable if procurement submits the PO within 10 business days of signature and they accept a slightly increased onboarding deposit (10% holdback).

I’ll give Kimberly a short note for external use once Legal confirms the redline language.

— Ben
Finance, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Order form clarifications: invoicing entity, VAT, and payment terms

All — legal is OK to proceed with the Ireland invoicing option but with the following constraints we should surface in the order form redline:

1) Invoicing Entity Section: Add an explicit selectable clause: "Invoices will be issued by Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) unless Customer elects Redwood Ireland Ltd (EU) during onboarding; Redwood will notify Customer of the effective invoice-issuing entity and first invoice may be issued by the US entity."

2) VAT/Withholding: Keep list prices gross. Include a reconciliation mechanism: "If Customer withholds VAT or other amounts, Customer must provide official tax withholding certificates within 30 days; Redwood will issue a credit note or gross-up as required following receipt of such certificates." Legal prefers the certificate requirement to limit exposure.

3) Payment Terms: Approve exception for Net60 in year one provided: (a) PO is received within 10 business days of signature; (b) 10% onboarding deposit invoiced upfront; (c) Redwood reserves right to revert to Net45 if credit review flags issues. Add these as optional checkboxes in Appendix B.

4) Quarterly Invoicing: Acceptable. For clarity add a line that quarterly invoicing is for administrative convenience only and does not change recognition of the annual commit — refunds/true-ups handled per Appendix.

I’ll produce a tracked-redline for the order form and the short one-page summary Procurement asked for. Ben — can you confirm finance is OK with the deposit wording? If so I’ll push the redline.

— Karthik
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Order form clarifications: invoicing entity, VAT, and payment terms

Karthik — deposit wording is fine. Confirming finance will accept the PO/10-business-day covenant and the 10% onboarding deposit. We prefer the credit-note path for withholding. Also recommend adding a short operational note for billing ops: contact + timeline for entity switch.

I’ll review the tracked redline when you share.

— Ben
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Procurement <procurement@cloudwave.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Final: Order form redline & next steps (attached)

Hi Elsa — thanks for the patience. Attached is a tracked-redline order form (RW_OrderForm_v3.pdf) and a short one-page summary that you can attach to your internal review (redline_summary.docx). Key commitments:

- Invoicing entity: We can invoice via Redwood Ireland Ltd; onboarding for the EU entity takes ~2 weeks. First invoice may be issued by Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) if Ireland is not yet live.
- VAT/withholding: Prices remain gross. If you withhold VAT, please provide the official withholding certificate within 30 days and we will issue a credit note/gross-up per the reconciliation process set out in the order form.
- Min commit cadence: Quarterly invoicing of the annual COMMIT is included as Option B in Appendix B. The Appendix clarifies recognition and refund/true-up rules.
- Net terms: Net60 for year one granted contingent on (i) PO submitted within 10 business days of signature, and (ii) 10% onboarding deposit invoiced at signing. Otherwise Net45 applies.

Next steps: Please confirm which billing entity you prefer (US vs Ireland) and whether you want the quarterly invoice option. If you confirm, we’ll finalize and circulate DocuSign within 24 hours.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: RW_OrderForm_v3.pdf (tracked-redline), redline_summary.docx (one-page summary)
